current.text: He asked out of San Antonio midway through last season and the Spurs let him go. He now plays for Portland.
He is not in Portland's projected starting five of Henderson, Lillard, Camara, Avdija and Clingan.
He is not getting the big minutes he needs to be useful, so he is not worth worrying about for fantasy.
He is technically a forward option in Portland, but the expert calls him a bad one.
Portland is short on forwards, and its rotation is thin after the eighth man, mostly at forward. That is his only clear path to more minutes.
Portland plays only 10 games in our fantasy playoff weeks, which the expert calls weak, and has three back-to-backs in that stretch.

durable.text: His fantasy value depends on a heavy minutes load. In a small role his line does not help any category.
